reading_evidence.note: Review uses only the verified public anchors and evidence levels recorded in the catalog; it does not claim access to unreviewed full book text.

item_reviews.title: Voice agents get a 100-millisecond head start
item_reviews.rationale: Streaming voice quality needs measured verification, current model facts, evaluation discipline and multimodal learning context.

item_reviews.title: Federated learning gets a public privacy proof
item_reviews.rationale: The mechanism connects most directly to defensible audit evidence, privacy boundaries, critical review and practical implementation workflows.

item_reviews.title: Anthropic turns enterprise AI delivery into a profession
item_reviews.rationale: Professional delivery depends on structured handoffs, cross-functional launch readiness, explicit prompt structure and repeatable practice.

item_reviews.title: Customer service prepares for agents on both sides
item_reviews.rationale: Two-sided agent service requires calibrated trust, bounded context, clarification and correct human/agent role selection.

item_reviews.title: One Agent Skills package, many Copilot workflows
item_reviews.rationale: Reusable Agent Skills are structured contracts whose context, prompt components and exportable templates must remain coherent across tools.

item_reviews.title: California tests the legal boundary for rogue agents
item_reviews.rationale: Rogue-agent accountability maps to failure handling, audit trails, incident playbooks and explicit adversarial review.
